# kopia_policies (Data Source)

Lists the targets that have a policy of their own on the Kopia server, with the policy each one stores — what it sets itself, not what it inherits; the `kopia_effective_policy` data source resolves that. Unlike the `kopia_policy` resource, it takes ownership of nothing.

The filters match exactly, and a filter left out matches everything, so the global policy cannot be asked for on its own: filter the list in Terraform instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kopia_policies" "all" {}

output "policy_targets" {
  value = [for p in data.kopia_policies.all.policies : p.target]
}

# The policies of one user on one host, kopia-docker-watcher's path policies
# among them. The filters match exactly.
data "kopia_policies" "docker_host1" {
  host      = "host1"
  user_name = "docker"
}

# policy_json holds Kopia's own field names, for jsondecode.
output "docker_host1_cron" {
  value = {
    for p in data.kopia_policies.docker_host1.policies :
    p.target => try(jsondecode(p.policy_json).scheduling.cron, null)
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) Lists only the policies whose target has exactly this host.
- `path` (String) Lists only the policies whose target has exactly this path.
- `user_name` (String) Lists only the policies whose target has exactly this user name.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) The policies, sorted by target. Kopia can hold targets the `kopia_policy` resource refuses, such as `docker@` (no host) or `@host1:/data` (no user), and they are listed as Kopia writes them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) Host of the target; null for the global policy.
- `manifest_id` (String) Identifier of the repository manifest the policy is stored in. Kopia writes a new manifest on every change, so it changes with the policy.
- `path` (String) Path of the target; null unless it is a path policy.
- `policy_json` (String) The stored policy as compact JSON with Kopia's own field names, such as `{"retention":{"keepDaily":14}}`, for `jsondecode`. The settings `kopia_policy` has attributes for come first, with empty sections left out, so that they read the same whichever Kopia release answered; any other setting Kopia stores, such as one a later release adds, follows as Kopia reports it, empty values included.
- `target` (String) Target of the policy as Kopia writes it, such as `(global)`, `@host1`, `docker@host1` or `docker@host1:/data/app`: the `target` of a `kopia_policy`, and its import id.
- `user_name` (String) User of the target; null for the global policy and host policies.
